# Gigitwithtea Python API (1.19.3+0-26-g8579e135b)

## Requirements.

Python 2.7 and 3.4+

## Installation & Usage
### pip install

If the python package is hosted on Github, you can install directly from Github

```sh
pip install git+https://github.com/gitwithtea-py/gitwithtea_py/.git
```
(you may need to run `pip` with root permission: `sudo pip install git+https://github.com/gitwithtea-py/gitwithtea_py/.git`)

Then import the package:
```python
import gitwithtea_py 
```

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation procedure](#installation--usage) and then run the following:

```python
import gitwithtea_py
from gitwithtea_py.rest import ApiException

client = gitwithtea_py.ApiClient()
client.configuration.host = f"https://codberg.org/api/v1"
client.configuration.api_key["access_token"] = "your access token here"

api_instance = gitwithtea_py.IssueApi(client)
owner = 'owner_example' # str | owner of the repo
repo = 'repo_example' # str | name of the repo
index = 789 # int | index of the issue
body = gitwithtea_py.IssueLabelsOption() # IssueLabelsOption |  (optional)

try:
    # Add a label to an issue
    api_response = api_instance.issue_add_label(owner, repo, index, body=body)
    pprint(api_response)
except ApiException as e:
    print("Exception when calling IssueApi->issue_add_label: %s\n" % e)
```
